name: Olimpbet
verdict: Russian bookmaker (BK Olimp LLC, olimp.bet); 97.5% owned by ZEVS LLC, which belongs 50/50 to two private individuals, Darina Denisova and Andrey Petukhov. Nothing found.
note: Betting brand; official partner of several KHL clubs (CSKA, Severstal, Spartak, Sochi, Amur) and of SKA per the archived club site. Front-of-shirt sponsor of Admiral Vladivostok in 2026-27; club announced a three-year extension of the partnership on 2025-03-26. Rating note 2026-10-03: fully private ownership (claims olimpbet-zevs-ownership, zevs-llc-ownership); no state link and no human-rights finding against the company located.
